title: MsgIdMap collision silently returns error with no audit trace
description: core/msgid_map.rs:25-55: when two different articles claim the same Message-ID, insert() returns a Database error with no log warning, no metric, no audit event. The caller may silently drop the error. Over time, undetected collisions cause deduplication failures and ghost articles in the group log. Fix: emit a tracing::warn! and/or record in the audit log on collision, so operators can detect duplicate-ID injection attempts.
